jobs.title: Publishing Officer
jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Pictet Asset Services provides custody, fund services and trading solutions for external asset managers, fund managers and institutional clients. We manage every aspect of the asset servicing value chain and our range of bespoke solutions include value-adding analytics, trading strategy support and digital front-end interfaces designed to provide an unrivalled customer experience.

The role of the function is to ensure the smooth running of the publishing production according to the SLAs, deadlines and roadmaps in place for in-house and third-party funds. A high level of client support (internal and external) will be expected.

Your role

• Code request as part of fund launch process (LEI, Bloomberg Tickers, etc…).

• Set up, control / update of static and dynamic data.

• Contribute to the efficient and accurate execution of publishing operations.

• Activate and publish request according to registration status.

• Disseminate legal fund documentations, monthly portfolio reports and No NAV calculation reports.

• Manage the chargeback of invoices.

• Collect and organize documents.

• Scan and archive documents and data.

Your profile

Knowledge /Technical skills:

• Master's degree in Finance, Economics or related

• 2-year experience in banking sector

• Good knowledge in fund operations, process and data analysis

• In-depth knowledge of MS Office and banking softwares (Multifonds, Luxis and Avaloq)

• Excellent knowledge of operational banking and legal perspective for funds

• Good knowledge in Python programming and being at ease with the use of AI Tools would be considered as distinguishing factors.

Soft skills:

• Rigor

• Attention to detail

• Organizational skills

• Team spirit

• Problem solving abilities

Language skills

• Fluent in french and english

Note

We will not accept any CVs from agencies.

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

Flexible and modern ways of working

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote the well-being of our employees through a set of flexible working arrangements, ranging from a work-from-home policy for eligible functions to opportunities for annualised part-time leave and extended parental leave.

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.title: Group Tax Expert
jobs.description:
Votre équipe

La division Corporate Functions regroupe les activités non bancaires du groupe Pictet et compte plus de 800 collaborateurs. Composées de spécialistes maîtrisant parfaitement l’ensemble des lignes de métier, les fonctions centrales s’articulent autour de plusieurs départements: Audit interne, Communication, Compliance, Corporate Office, Finances, Fiscalité, Juridique, Ressources humaines, Risques et Sécurité de l’information.

Basé à Genève, le département Group Tax a pour mission de gérer la situation fiscale du Groupe, en assurant la conformité avec les exigences légales et réglementaires, la gestion des risques fiscaux, la préservation de la réputation de Pictet et le maintien de relations de qualité avec les administrations fiscales.

Group Tax cherche un/e expert/e en fiscalité pour intégrer l’équipe Group Tax Office , chargée principalement du pilotage de projets fiscaux stratégiques au sein du Groupe, de la gestion des risques et des contrôles fiscaux, ainsi que de la coordination en cas de demandes de renseignements ou d’audits.

Votre rôle

• Participer au pilotage des projets fiscaux stratégiques, en apportant votre expertise sur les impôts directs et indirects (impôt anticipé, TVA, droit de timbre), les taxes transactionnelles et l’imposition à la source.

• Mettre en place et réaliser des contrôles et audits fiscaux, formuler des recommandations et suivre leur mise en œuvre.

• Évaluer les risques fiscaux et élaborer des stratégies de mitigation.

• Superviser les processus de classification et de reporting client pour garantir la conformité aux exigences FATCA, CRS et QI, dans le cadre de la transparence fiscale.

• Collaborer étroitement avec les autres départements pour intégrer les aspects fiscaux dans les projets transverses.

• Suivre l’évolution du droit et de la réglementation en matière de fiscalité.

Votre profil

• Diplôme universitaire en droit ou en sciences économiques.

• Expérience de 5 à 10 ans en fiscalité, idéalement acquise en cabinet d’avocats ou dans l’une des « Big Four ».

• Capacité à travailler de manière autonome, en faisant preuve d’esprit d’initiative.

• Excellentes compétences analytiques, sens de la résolution de problèmes et capacité à proposer des améliorations aux pratiques actuelles.

• Maîtrise des applications MS Office usuelles.

• Excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais ; la connaissance de l’allemand est un atout.

Réf. GTE/LJ/VB

Note

Nous n’accepterons aucun CV transmis par des agences.

Diversité & Inclusion

Pictet est un employeur garantissant l’égalité des chances et s’engage à créer un environnement diversifié. Nous respectons chaque individu et veillons à favoriser leur inclusion au sein de l’entreprise.

jobs.title: Finance Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Your team

At Pictet, our Technology and Operations divisions work in close partnership to deliver innovative, secure, and efficient solutions that drive the Group’s success. The Technology division develops and integrates advanced software solutions, such as portfolio management systems, trading platforms, and banking applications – playing a key role in the Group’s digital transformation and client value creation. The Operations division ensures the secure and efficient processing of banking transactions and investment funds, maintaining regulatory compliance and managing operational risks to support the reliability of our financial services.

Together, Technology and Operations form the backbone of Pictet’s ability to deliver outstanding client experiences, playing a key role in the Group’s digital transformation and value creation.

You will be part of the Finance Pictet Tech & Operations team. The team plays a pivotal role in the financial steering of the division, by providing timely, relevant financial data and reports in aligning financial strategies with business objectives and delivering actionable insights to stakeholders.

Your role

As a member of the Finance Tech & Operations team, you will own the development of financial dashboards, manage finance analytical data models, automate reporting production processes, and act as the primary Finance liaison with the Central Data Engineering team. You will contribute to both the operational continuity of financial processes and the longer-term transformation of Finance analytics within Pictet Technology and Operations.

jobs.title: Operations Officer - Alternative investments
jobs.description:
Your team

Pictet Alternative Advisors is a leading alternative investment specialist with expertise in hedge funds, private equity and global real estate. The Geneva- and London-based team constructs, manages and advises on portfolios of alternative investment solutions for institutional and private clients.

The Group has strong development ambitions for Pictet Alternative Advisors for the coming years, notably to expand its product offering to include additional asset classes and to further develop its institutional client base. In view of these developments, Pictet Alternative Advisors is looking to hire an Operations Officer to steer its development.

Based in Geneva, you will be joining a busy team at the core of supporting a strong level of activity and growth across our alternative investments platform. You will provide operational support across a diversified range of investment strategies, as well as managed accounts.

Your role

• Managing and coordinating operations linked to the investment teams (Products and mandates)
• Providing support for the investment teams, management and internal clients.
• Monitoring NAV calculations, FX hedging, reporting, transactions and client services.
• Coordinating with all service providers (legal, tax, compliance, administrators, back-office, etc.).
• Monitoring risks and investment constraints.
• Working on various occasional and recurrent projects (e.g. TER calculations).
• Optimising and automating processes (IT development).

Your profile

• At least five years’ experience in a similar role in a fund department or with an asset manager.
• Proven practical knowledge of alternative products (Hedge Funds, Private Equity, Real Estate) operations management.
• Rigorous, with excellent numeracy skills and a keen attention to detail.
• A certain ability to deal with issues/topics with specialists from various businesses (investment managers, tax, compliance, etc.), with excellent verbal and writing skills in these particular situations.
• Advanced user of Excel and generally at ease with new IT systems. Ideally with an AI interest or experience.
• At ease expressing yourself in both French and English, with the relevant written proficiency to draft documentation and discuss complex matters with both internal and external parties, whether native speakers or not.
• Must be resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate.

As the chosen applicant you will show energy and enthusiasm in your work and be rigorous in your approach. You will also stand out owing to your excellent teamworking skills. Furthermore, you will be trustworthy, able to show discretion and keep in mind that client’s interests and excellence in what you deliver is what matters the most.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

jobs.title: Senior Finance Manager (12-months contract)
jobs.description:
Your team

The Corporate Functions division encompasses the Group’s non-banking activities and comprises over 600 employees. Staffed by specialists with deep expertise across all business lines, the central functions are organised into various group departments: Communication, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Corporate Office, Risk, and Taxation.

Group Finance is dedicated to ensuring robust financial management and reporting, supporting the Group’s strategic objectives through effective financial operations, strong internal controls, and compliance with regulatory requirements.

As a member of the Group Finance community, the Senior Finance Manager will join the Accounting, Data & Reporting team, reporting to the Head of Financial Reporting and Regulatory Reporting Solutions. The role will involve close collaboration with all members of the Accounting, Data & Reporting team, as well as with other internal teams, to ensure the effective management of financial operations and reporting.

Your role

As a Senior Finance Manager, you will play a key role in overseeing and executing core financial processes within the Group Finance function. You will leverage your strong finance expertise and understanding of the banking industry to ensure the accuracy, integrity, and timeliness of financial data and reporting.

You will be responsible for the following tasks:

• Participate in finance-related projects, including process improvements, system enhancements, and implementation of new regulatory requirements.
• Oversee daily financial operations, including data maintenance, reconciliations, and operational controls to ensure accuracy and compliance.
• Contribute to the preparation and delivery of financial, regulatory and management reports, ensuring consistency with both regulatory standards and internal policies.
• Collaborate closely with all members of the Accounting, Data & Reporting team and other internal stakeholders, including Finance, Risk, and IT teams, to gather requirements, resolve issues, and drive process optimization.
• Support internal and external audits by preparing documentation, responding to queries, and implementing recommendations.
• Maintain the Internal Control System (ICS), to ensure adherence to internal policies and external regulations.
• Contribute to the development and documentation of finance processes and procedures.

Your profile

• Master’s degree in Finance or equivalent.
• At least ten years’ experience in the banking industry within a Finance department and/or in external audit.
• Strong knowledge of financial reporting, accounting principles, and regulatory requirements in the banking sector.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial data and provide actionable insights.
• Proven experience in managing financial operations, controls, and reporting processes.
• Strong proactivity, adaptability, autonomy, curiosity, and a can-do attitude.
• Excellent collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and functional stakeholders.
• Fluent in French and English.
• Must be a resident in Switzerland.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies.

jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks.

By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

Your role

• Monitor orders for UCI share subscriptions/redemptions, transfers and conversions.

• Prepare and send out confirmations and reports to promoters, distributors and other fund intermediaries.

• Respond rapidly to different requests from clients (inside and outside the Group) to guarantee that a quality service is provided that meets the requirements of a demanding client.

• Manage client commissions and dividends for in-house and third-party funds.

• Manage events on Funds (in kind transfers, launches, liquidations…).

• Work on automating various configurations within the tool “Multifonds Global Investor”, primarily focusing on Fund setup, by implementing key controls.

• Play a coordinating role in fund-related events across teams, including fund launches, compartments, classes, mergers, and liquidations.

• Review Fund’s prospectuses to ensure alignment between promoter requests and system feasibility.

• Offer technical and functional support to other teams within the service.

Your profile

• Extensive knowledge of the Transfer Agent business and all-round understanding of fund administration processes

• Unversity degree in Economics or Finance

• 5 years' experience in similar position

• Fluent in french and english

• Excellent knowledge of the “MFGI - Multifonds Global Investor” tool and proven experience in its usage.

• Extensive knowledge of the Office suite.

• SQL knowledge is a must have.

• Flexibility

• Ability to handle stress.

• Rigor in checking, sending, confirming and monitoring orders.

• Enthusiasm and drive and ability to show initiative in solving problems.

• Enquiring mind and ability to learn quickly.

• Team player.

業務概要

オルタナティブ投資の中でも、プライベート資産（プライベートエクイティ、プライベートデット、不動産）およびこれらの低流動性資産を組み入れるマルチアセット戦略の開発を担当するプロダクトスペシャリストとして、受託者責任（fiduciary）および説明責任（accountability）を果たしつつ、ビジネスの拡大に貢献していただきます。

金融市場およびプライベート資産に関する専門知識を活かし、グローバル運用部門や営業部門など関連部署と連携しながら新規案件の獲得や既存案件の管理を行います。さらに、商品開発・マーケティング・バックオフィス等の社内ステークホルダーと協働し、クライアントニーズに即した商品組成やソリューション構築、マルチアセット戦略の開発に積極的に関与していただきます。

主な職務内容

• 顧客への運用ソリューションの提案

• 担当プロダクトの顧客向け説明およびビジネスデベロップメント活動（営業部門との協働）

jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5000 people.

Your role

Pictet is seeking to recruit a Marketing Manager (1-Year Contract) to work in the Marketing Asia - HKG team to support and coordinate marketing activities for Pictet Asset Management in Asia excluding Japan, contributing to brand visibility and business development in the region.

• Coordinate and execute regional marketing strategies and campaigns, including advertising, events, web, social media, and other marketing initiatives.

• Assist in the development and production of marketing collaterals, from information and data collection through to distribution, ensuring consistency with brand guidelines.

• Monitor the publication of global marketing content and support local content production and translation, liaising with external service providers as needed.

• Demonstrate creativity in developing innovative marketing campaigns and designing thoughtful client gifts that are highly valued and appreciated by recipients.

• Work closely with internal stakeholders, including local business teams, compliance, and headquarter marketing counterparts, to deliver marketing activities.

• Help maintain and update the firm’s web, digital, and social media platforms, ensuring content is accurate and engaging.

• Manage relationships with external vendors for the production of marketing assets, campaigns, events, and other communications materials.

• Track and report on marketing performance using analytics and KPIs, providing insights for ongoing improvement.

Your profile

• University graduate in Marketing, Communications, or a relevant discipline.

• 5-10 years of solid marketing and communications experience in financial institutions is highly preferred.

• Strong attention to detail and creativity.

• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and desktop publishing tools.

• Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) in English and Chinese.

• Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively in a diverse, multicultural environment.

• A proactive, results-oriented team player with a passion for marketing.

jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 31 offices in financial centers worldwide, currently employing more than 5’000 people. The group is owned and managed by eight partners and stands out as a company with an entrepreneurial spirit and loyalty. Pictet has been present in Zurich since 1982 where it employs over 200 people. The Zurich branch is located at the Leuenhof, one of the most historic buildings on the prestigious Bahnhofstrasse.

We are looking for a passionate Chef de Rang to join our team in Zurich. As a key member of our motivated team, you will be working for Food & Beverage activities, in our beautiful premises in the heart of Zurich.
You will bring your communication skills, your ability to work independently and your good knowledge of foreign languages to a service-oriented team that will appreciate your motivation, high quality standards and networked thinking. Your organizational skills and thoughtful approach to your work will enable you to maintain an overview even in hectic situations. You will use your sense of responsibility, pleasant manner and outstanding client focus to support our own staff as well as our clients.

Your role

You will manage the activities of the restaurant dedicated to the Bank's clients and management, as well as external and internal events (banquets and catering). You will be the main contact for the kitchen and reception teams and coordinate and perform all the Food & Beverage activities. As a Food & Beverage Coordinator, you provide a first-class Food & Beverage service with an emphasis on quality and always maintain absolute discretion. Working hours are primarily during office hours, with only occasional evening shifts.

Your responsibilities include the following:
• Plan and organize client lunches and hospitality service with or without external catering service
• Ensure the setting up of lounges or banquets according to the reservation forecasts and menus
• Take orders and propose food and wine pairings, if necessary
• Manage the wine cellar in coordination with Geneva’s F&B team
• Monitor the service and ensure its excellence
• Help to prepare client-facing events

• Perform general administrative duties
• Participate in the establishment and improvement of standards and procedures

## Descrizione

The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 31 offices in financial centers worldwide, currently employing more than 5’000 people. The group is owned and managed by eight partners and stands out as a company with an entrepreneurial spirit and loyalty. Pictet has been present in Zurich since 1982 where it employs over 200 people. The Zurich branch is located at the Leuenhof, one of the most historic buildings on the prestigious Bahnhofstrasse.

## Il tuo team

Siamo alla ricerca di un/a **Chef de Rang** appassionato/a per unirsi al nostro team a Zurigo. Come membro chiave del nostro team motivato, lavorerai per le attività di Food & Beverage nei nostri splendidi locali nel cuore di Zurigo.

Porti le tue capacità comunicative, la tua autonomia e la buona conoscenza delle lingue straniere in un team orientato al servizio che apprezzerà la tua motivazione, i tuoi elevati standard qualitativi e il tuo pensiero connesso. Le tue capacità organizzative e il tuo approccio riflessivo al lavoro ti permetteranno di mantenere la panoramica anche in situazioni frenetiche. Userai il tuo senso di responsabilità, il tuo modo piacevole e il tuo eccezionale focus sul cliente per supportare sia il nostro personale che i nostri clienti.

## Mansioni

- Gestirai le attività del ristorante dedicato ai clienti e alla direzione della Banca, nonché gli eventi interni ed esterni (banchetti e catering)
- Sarai il principale punto di contatto per i team di cucina e reception e coordinerai ed eseguirai tutte le attività di Food & Beverage
- In qualità di Food & Beverage Coordinator, offrirai un servizio Food & Beverage di prima classe con enfasi sulla qualità e manterrai sempre la massima discrezione
- L’orario di lavoro è principalmente durante l’orario d’ufficio, con solo occasionali turni serali

## Responsabilità
- Pianificare e organizzare pranzi per clienti e servizi di ospitalità con o senza servizio di catering esterno
- Garantire l’allestimento di salotti o banchetti secondo le previsioni di prenotazione e i menu
- Prendere ordini e proporre abbinamenti cibo-vino, se necessario
- Gestire la cantina in coordinamento con il team F&B di Ginevra
- Monitorare il servizio e garantirne l’eccellenza
- Aiutare a preparare eventi rivolti ai clienti
- Garantire la manutenzione del materiale (posateria, bicchieri...) nonché il suo inventario
- Eseguire compiti amministrativi generali
- Partecipare all’istituzione e al miglioramento di standard e procedure

## Requisiti
- Formazione/apprendistato in gestione alberghiera
- Almeno 5 anni di esperienza in un ambiente di ospitalità di alto livello o in un ristorante di successo
- Madrelingua tedesca, fluente in inglese; la conoscenza del francese sarebbe un vantaggio
- Orientamento al servizio, aspetto curato e sicuro
- Residenza in Svizzera obbligatoria

## Nota
- Non accetteremo CV tramite agenzie

## Diversità e Inclusione
Pictet è un datore di lavoro che offre pari opportunità ed è impegnato a creare un ambiente diversificato. Rispettiamo tutti gli individui e cerchiamo la loro inclusione sul posto di lavoro.

## Contatto
- Candidati ora
- Salva l’annuncio
- Invia via email a un contatto
- Torna all’elenco
